title: Book Two · Chapter 81: The Bowl That Is Too Small
story:
Autumn arrives with cooler evenings. One Sunday, Mum plans a simple lunch. They will make little balls of dough. Ronan asks to help. Mum has not taken the flour down yet.

“I can pour,” he says.

Mum gives him a small cup for the flour. She asks for the wide bowl from the lower shelf. Ronan brings a smaller one instead. It is closer to his hands.

“That looks easier,” he says.

Mum measures the first cup. Ronan pours it in. The second cup makes a little white hill. Mum adds water. The hill slips over the edge.

Ronan stops with the cup in his hand. A line of flour crosses the table.

“Not wide enough,” he says.

Dad brings a larger bowl. Mum moves the flour into it. Ronan wipes the table with a dry cloth first. Then she lets him wipe it again with a damp one.

“Now the water,” she says.

This time he pours slowly. Mum mixes. The flour changes from loose dust into soft dough. Dad puts a little flour on the clean board.

Ronan presses his finger into the dough. The mark stays there. He makes a second mark beside it.

“Eyes,” he says.

Mum folds the dough over. The face disappears. Dad makes a very small sad noise. Ronan laughs.

They roll little pieces between their hands. Mum's pieces are almost the same size. Dad's are larger. Ronan's first one is long and thin.

“That will cook faster,” Mum says. “Make the next one a little shorter.”

He puts it aside and tries again. Soon there is a neat row in front of him. He wants to make fifty. Mum shows him the amount left.

“We need lunch, not a whole shop.”

Dad takes care of the hot pot. Ronan stays away from the steam. He brings the bowls and spoons to the table. Lunch is ready. Mum puts one of his long pieces in his bowl.

“It kept its shape,” she says.

Ronan tastes it after it cools. It is soft and warm. He tastes Mum's piece too. To him, they taste the same.

After lunch, he volunteers to wash the wide bowl. The water makes it heavy. Mum empties it first. He turns it slowly in his hands and wipes the flour from the rim.

Dad points to the small bowl on the shelf.

“We can use that one tomorrow.”

“For a smaller lunch?” Ronan asks.

“For my very large eyes.”
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

bowl＝碗；flour＝面粉；pour＝倒入。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan做饭时先遇到什么实际问题？
2. 全家怎样一起完成午饭？

## 读句子

**Dad / brings / a larger bowl.** Dad／拿来／一个更大的碗。
